g.data-info: takes documents in, virus-scans and reads them (OCR, classifier, LayoutLMv3), extracts and checks the fields, matches the vendor.
g.aria-label: Document & Vendor: takes documents in, virus-scans and reads them (OCR, classifier, LayoutLMv3), extracts and checks the fields, matches the vendor.

g.data-links: ev-approval.decided ev-approval.requested ev-contract.generated ev-contract.signed ev-document.classified kafka models pg redis sla temporal
g.data-info: turns a quote into a purchase request, routes it by amount, enforces who may approve, keeps budgets, stock, licences (anomaly model) and the invoice ledger.
g.aria-label: Approval & Inventory: turns a quote into a purchase request, routes it by amount, enforces who may approve, keeps budgets, stock, licences (anomaly model) and the invoice ledger.

g.data-links: ev-approval.decided ev-approval.requested ev-contract.generated ev-contract.signed ev-document.classified kafka models pg renew sanctions temporal
g.data-info: writes the contract after the final approval, collects the e-signature, reads clauses (Legal-BERT) and scores vendor risk; a sanctioned vendor can't be signed.
g.aria-label: Contract & Risk: writes the contract after the final approval, collects the e-signature, reads clauses (Legal-BERT) and scores vendor risk; a sanctioned vendor can't be signed.

g.data-links: ev-approval.decided ev-approval.requested ev-contract.generated ev-contract.signed ev-document.classified kafka mail pg
g.data-info: listens to 17 event topics and emails whoever must act next, from templates admins edit in the Control Panel.
g.aria-label: Notification agent: listens to 17 event topics and emails whoever must act next, from templates admins edit in the Control Panel.

g.data-info: sign-up, login and roles; serves the business rules every agent reads, changed live without a deploy.
g.aria-label: Auth service: sign-up, login and roles; serves the business rules every agent reads, changed live without a deploy.

g.data-info: answers questions from contracts, documents and records (retrieval-augmented, local LLM), only from what the signed-in user may see.
g.aria-label: Assistant (chatbot): answers questions from contracts, documents and records (retrieval-augmented, local LLM), only from what the signed-in user may see.

g.data-info: carries every hand-off between agents as an event. 23 topics; each agent has its own login and may use only its own topics. An event is saved in the same transaction as the change (outbox), so a restart loses nothing.
g.aria-label: Kafka events: carries every hand-off between agents as an event. 23 topics; each agent has its own login and may use only its own topics. An event is saved in the same transaction as the change (outbox), so a restart loses nothing.

g.data-info: runs the long waits that must survive restarts: approval deadlines with reminders and escalation, and contract renewal notices. Workers in Approval and Contract poll it.
g.aria-label: Temporal: runs the long waits that must survive restarts: approval deadlines with reminders and escalation, and contract renewal notices. Workers in Approval and Contract poll it.

g.data-info: reminders at 50% and 80%, then escalation (run by Approval).
g.aria-label: Approval SLAs: reminders at 50% and 80%, then escalation (run by Approval).

g.data-info: notice before a contract expires (run by Contract).
